source: Official public 2026-04-09 build; ability definitions, selection range validation and volley projectile behavior read from temporary reference analysis. Independent implementation in project; original source/art not imported.

rules.range_origin: centroid of selected living capable ready actors
rules.scatter: independent X and Y uniform within +/- radius * 0.4
rules.damage_source: first ready actor attack damage, not unused damage_per_unit definition
rules.landing: nearest living enemy with distance strictly less than 21; one victim per arrow, no area damage, fixed ground target
rules.shield: no directional block: original ability passes a null attacker

implementation.variant: archer base kind retained for existing art, independent per-regiment combat and individual stats
implementation.entry: normal main menu / legion battle / bow loadout button / deploy / select longbow / V or Volley button / click ground
implementation.layouts: persistent buttons in editable battle_hud.tscn; runtime does not reposition them
implementation.enemy_archers: player loadout does not modify them

known_differences_or_unverified: No new original-runtime same-condition volley capture this turn; parameters verified against public build analysis, not latest Steam Playtest.
Battle-owned deterministic random stream instead of original global random stream; exact scatter sequence is not identical.
Reuses current 64x64 archer art and local hit/corpse response, not unique original longbow art.
Uses project projection, terrain boundaries and existing sound samples; original voice line not added, actual audio mix not listened to this turn.
UI rejects out-of-battlefield targets and does not spend ability while paused; this project behavior is not proven identical to original pause/input behavior.
Full ability/units catalog, blink, flight, other traits and native grid/lifecycle differences remain outstanding.
